title: West Bengal Panchayat & Municipal Property Tax Online Payment Guide
summary: Step-by-step instructions for paying West Bengal Gram Panchayat property tax and municipal taxes online via GRIPS and municipal portals.
body:
Property owners and commercial shop operators across West Bengal panchayat areas and municipalities can now clear property tax liabilities online.

Filing & Payment Steps:
• Panchayat Tax Online Portal: Access the designated Gram Panchayat portal or GRIPS payment gateway.
• Assessment Number Lookup: Enter your property holding number or assessee ID to fetch tax dues.
• e-Challan Generation: Complete online payment via UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card and download the official payment receipt.
